title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
hook: The up-tempo "I just want you for my own" period: two statements of the rising-and-falling opening line, the leap to the high "make my wish come true", and the title line closing on the long held G

evidence.summary: Primary: Hooktheory public JSON "Pre-Chorus and Chorus" (SHA-256 f4ef90bf...), G major, 150 BPM, notes 0-33 frozen as a derived MIDI at PPQ 9600 with documented edits: Hooktheory-only sixteenths E4 D4 (notes 25-26) dropped, the "all I want for Christmas" run (notes 23-29) re-timed to the recording, three holds lengthened to the recording. Reference: the lead vocal of the original recording (official lyric video NrGGIoDL6U4, 4:01 album version), Demucs htdemucs vocal stem, pyin segments plus CQT: 31 of 32 pitches equal in order at shift 0 (the second-line A4, position 9, is only a sliding stub); onsets within 0.5 beat except the retimed run. No second symbolic transcription was available (MIDI Show files need a login), so the independent evidence is the recording itself. The phrase shares its melody with the verse in the slow intro and the repeat at 104 s; the verse, which starts on G3, cannot be joined to it (span 19).

corpus.notes: Pitch audit against the original recording (vocal stem pyin + CQT); matching clip kept outside the corpus at out/catalogue-2026-11-22/mariah/sources/original-clip-82.0-99.5s.flac: 82.0-99.5 s of the official lyric video audio; the first sung note starts 1.43 s into the clip. Alignment kept unvalidated; not indexed in the corpus.
